Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Banking and Finance T-bills auction: Government records 16% undersubscription; interest rates register mixed performance across yield curve Source : Joy Business 18 October 2026 6:53pm Audio By Carbonatix
Demand for treasury bills slumped as the government missed its treasury bills target for the first time in several weeks.
According to the Bank of Ghana's auction results, the government recorded an undersubscription of 16%.
The Treasury received GH¢4.17 billion of the total bids but accepted GH¢3.48 billion.
According to the auction results, the majority of the bids came from the 91-day instrument.
A little over GH¢2.9 billion of the bids were tendered, representing 70.5% of the total bids. The uptake was, however, about GH¢2.2 billion.
The 182-day bill received bids of about GH¢1.1 billion. The bids accepted were GH¢692.30.
For the 364-day bill, a little above GH¢1.1 billion in bids were tendered. The Treasury accepted GH¢ 587.61 million of the bids.
Meanwhile, interest rates recorded mixed performance on the yield curve.
The yield on the 91-day bill increased by 2.0 basis points to 4.62%.
Similarly, the yield on the 182-day bill went up to 6.31% from 6.27% the previous week.
However, the yield on the 364-day bill dropped by 4.0 basis points to 9.71%.
